purpose: Record evidence-path expansion discovered and shipped after the initial calibration baseline. This is not a weight change and does not create ROBUST-v2.

trajectory_substrate.note: These are candidate prerequisites from warehouse sale fields plus governed district evidence. They are not newly persisted Watchdog Scores.

behavior: Select block, lot and qualifier from property_lookups.
Resolve subject evidence through existing service-only lookup_sr1a_subject_evidence RPC in bounded batches.
Use municipal verified-sale median PPSF multiplied by governed subject living area as an independent value path for O when a subject match is available.
Store subject source, provider version, living area and match quality in score evidence.
If subject evidence is unavailable or ambiguous, fail closed for O only; the rest of ROBUST can still score under missing-evidence renormalization.
Retain saved comparable value as the preferred independent-value path when it is available and meaningfully independent from the ratio-derived market estimate.

governance.reason: The change restores and evidences an intended O input path. It does not alter the ROBUST dimensions or weights. New evidence can legitimately increase evidence coverage on later observations.
governance.ambiguity_rule: Ambiguous qualifier matches do not produce subject evidence.
governance.missing_evidence_rule: No synthetic O value is created when subject evidence does not resolve.

next_calibration_action: Accumulate or dry-run a representative ROBUST-v1 cohort with real Trajectory observations and expanded O evidence, then rerun property/scripts/robust_score_calibration.sql before considering any weight or evidence-gate change.
